---
name: dos-pixel-art
description: "Kontrakt grafiki DOS pixel-art dla retro-ski-jumping. Uzyj przy sprite'ach skoczka, scenie stadionu, foncie bitmapowym i generatorze linii K/HS: siatka, palety, zasady rysowania i zakazy."

# dos-pixel-art â€” kontrakt oprawy (P15 i dalej)

Zrodlo prawdy: `docs/ART_UI_AUDIO.md`. Ponizsze to skrot wykonawczy.

## Siatka i render

- Obraz logiczny **960Ă—540**, 16:9. Skala calkowita (2Ă— na 1920Ă—1080),
  tryb â€žDopasuj" z nearest-neighbour dla mniejszych okien. Nigdy nie
  rozciagac proporcji. Brak antyaliasingu.
- Skoczek stojacy: sylwetka ~36â€“48 px, narty 48â€“68 px. Pozycja lotna
  i oba ladowania rozpoznawalne bez HUD.
- Font bitmapowy 12â€“16 px, cyfry stalej szerokosci; tytuly 24â€“32 px lub
  dokladne wielokrotnosci. Polskie znaki obowiazkowe:
  `Ä…Ä‡Ä™Ĺ‚Ĺ„ĂłĹ›ĹşĹĽ Ä„Ä†Ä�Ĺ�Ĺ�Ă“ĹšĹąĹ»`.
- Tla na tej samej siatce, klastry 2â€“6 px + selektywne detale.
  Dithering tylko na wybranych przejsciach.
- ZAKAZY: CRT, bloom, motion blur, scanlines, pelnoekranowy szum,
  fotograficzne ziarno, plastikowe kontury.

## Palety bazowe (DESIGN)

`#121D2B` granat Â· `#91B4CB` cien sniegu Â· `#E7F0EF` snieg Â·
`#536C7A` stal Â· `#244637` las Â· `#F1BD79` cieple swiatlo Â·
`#F3EAD1` tekst. Oznaczenia: niebieski `#286BC6`, czerwony `#D64D53`,
zielony `#3FA865` â€” zawsze tez ksztalt/pozycja/etykieta, nigdy sam kolor.

## Generator oznaczen (kontrakt, nie tabela wspolrzednych)

Dane: `span = HS â�’ K`; czerwony `[K, HS]`; niebieski `[K â�’ span, K]`;
zielony `[fallLine â�’ span, fallLine]`. Linie poprzeczne co 5 m
w `[P â�’ 10, HS]`; HS zawsze markerem. Podzialki boczne co 1 m od
`ceil(K/2)` do `HS+5`, podpisy rzadziej. Renderer liczy z `distanceMap`;
zakaz osobnej tabeli wspolrzednych w rendererze. Czerwone pasy to pasy
przy brzegach, nie wypelnienie stoku. â€žDo prowadzenia" to cienka zielona
linia + `DO PROWADZENIA ~x,x m` w HUD (tylda = prognoza).

## Banki sprite'ow (budzet startowy)

Skoczek bazowy + maski kolorow, osobne warstwy nart i ciala: belka,
ruszenie, zjazd, 5â€“8 faz wybicia, bank pozycji lotnych, 4â€“6 faz
telemarku, 3â€“5 ladowania rownoleglego, amortyzacja, odjazd, hamowanie,
utrata rownowagi, upadek. Ulozenie sprite'a ze stanu fizyki; sprite nie
moze pokazac kontaktu 15 px przed rzeczywista kolizja. Kqtne pozy â€”
bank recznie poprawionych klatek albo obroty bez wygladzania
poprawione w atlasie.

## Pipeline assetow

`imagine-pixel` (snap obowiazkowy, tylko PNG) â†’ `pixelart-cleanup`
(halo/orphany) â†’ atlas + manifest z pochodzeniem/licencja. Do builda
tylko zoptymalizowane eksporty; mastery poza buildem. Kazdy zewnetrzny
asset runtime wymaga jawnego pochodzenia; nie kopiuj materialow SJ3.
Skala sprite'a i Canvas2D zatwierdzone pomiarem P15 (p50/p95/p99,
dlugie klatki, aktywny snieg i wiatr).

## Gdy proceduralne rysowanie (fillRect/pixelLine/fillPixelPolygon) nie daje
## czytelnego efektu â€” zgoda uzytkownika z 16.09.2026, PKG-008 kontynuacja

Wolno uzyc CLI `gen-ai` (Picsart, zainstalowane i zalogowane w tym srodowisku;
`gen-ai image --help`, `gen-ai character --help` do spojnej postaci na wielu
generacjach, `gen-ai edit-image` do poprawek, `gen-ai remove-bg`/`vectorize`
do oczyszczenia) zamiast dalszego, wielogodzinnego strojenia recznych
wspolrzednych `pixelLine`, jesli sylwetka/scena nadal nie czyta sie dobrze po
rozsadnej liczbie iteracji. Wygenerowany PNG nadal przechodzi przez zasade
"jedna siatka pikseli, bez antyaliasingu" â€” snapuj/czysc go do siatki (nearest-
neighbour, `imageSmoothingEnabled=false` przy imporcie, ewentualny krok
pixelart-cleanup) zanim trafi do gry, i zapisz pochodzenie/prompt w manifescie
assetow zgodnie z zasada wyzej. To narzedzie na trudnosc rysowania, nie zamiana
calego pipeline'u na jeden strzal AI bez kontroli jakosci.

/**
 * PKG-008 / P42 â€” zrzuty i nagrania do bramki V (akceptacja oprawy przez uĹĽytkownika).
 *
 * Spec nie sprawdza zachowania gry (to juĹĽ robiÄ… jump.spec.ts / competition.spec.ts /
 * persistence.spec.ts) â€” zbiera wyĹ‚Ä…cznie dowĂłd obrazowy do docs/evidence/PKG-008,
 * te same ekrany i fazy co PKG-007, ĹĽeby daĹ‚o siÄ™ porĂłwnaÄ‡ przed/po.
 */

import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test'
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve } from 'node:path'

const DIR = 'docs/evidence/PKG-008/browser-artifacts'
const OVERLOAD_REASON = 'zbyt dĹ‚uga przerwa klatki'

type JumpDebug = {
  phase: string
  tick: number
  gate: number
  speedKmh: number
  heightAboveSurface: number
  distance: number | null
  status: string | null
  terminalPhase: string | null
} | null

type CompetitionDebug = {
  view: 'handover' | 'start' | 'jump' | 'bots' | 'result' | 'round-summary' | 'withdraw-confirm' | 'finished'
  status: 'active' | 'complete' | 'cancelled'
  roundId: 'qualification' | 'first' | 'final'
  nextStartIndex: number
  handoverReady: boolean
  startPhase: 'red' | 'yellow' | 'green' | null
  lastResult: { participantId: string; distanceHalfMeters: number; totalTenths: number } | null
  jump: { phase: string; tick: number; heightAboveSurface: number; status: string | null } | null
}

type Snapshot = {
  screen: string
  paused: boolean
  pauseReason: string
  menuSelection: 'training' | 'competition' | 'replay'
  jump: JumpDebug
  competition: CompetitionDebug | null
  replay: { available: boolean } | null
}

function snapshot(page: Page): Promise<Snapshot> {
  return page.evaluate(() => (
    window as unknown as { __retroDebugSnapshot: () => Snapshot }
  ).__retroDebugSnapshot())
}

async function resumeIfOverloaded(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  const state = await snapshot(page)
  if (!state.paused) return
  expect(state.pauseReason).toBe(OVERLOAD_REASON)
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  await page.waitForTimeout(16)
}

async function waitForJump(page: Page, predicate: string, timeoutMs = 30_000): Promise<void> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs
  const check = (source: string): Promise<boolean> =>
    page.evaluate((expression: string) => {
      const state = (window as unknown as { __retroDebugSnapshot: () => Snapshot }).__retroDebugSnapshot()
      if (!state.jump) return false
      return new Function('jump', `return ${expression}`)(state.jump) as boolean
    }, source)

  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (await check(predicate)) return
    await resumeIfOverloaded(page)
    await page.waitForTimeout(16)
  }
  throw new Error(`Warunek nie zostaĹ‚ speĹ‚niony w ${timeoutMs} ms: ${predicate}`)
}

async function waitForCompetition(
  page: Page,
  predicate: (competition: CompetitionDebug) => boolean,
  description: string,
  timeoutMs = 45_000,
): Promise<CompetitionDebug> {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    await resumeIfOverloaded(page)
    const state = await snapshot(page)
    if (state.competition && predicate(state.competition)) return state.competition
    await page.waitForTimeout(12)
  }
  throw new Error(`Nie osiÄ…gniÄ™to stanu: ${description}`)
}

async function openJumpScreen(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.goto('/', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' })
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  await expect.poll(async () => (await snapshot(page)).screen).toBe('menu')
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 8; attempt += 1) {
    const state = await snapshot(page)
    if (state.screen === 'jump' && !state.paused) return
    if (state.paused) expect(state.pauseReason).toBe(OVERLOAD_REASON)
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    await page.waitForTimeout(24)
  }
  const final = await snapshot(page)
  expect(final.screen).toBe('jump')
  expect(final.paused).toBe(false)
}

/** Minimalny skok kolejnego zawodnika w konkursie â€” bez dodatkowych zrzutĂłw/asercji. */
async function playMinimalHumanJump(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await waitForCompetition(page, (c) => c.view === 'handover' && c.handoverReady, 'gotowy handover (kolejny)')
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  await waitForCompetition(page, (c) => c.view === 'start' && c.startPhase === 'red', 'czerwona (kolejny)')
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  await waitForCompetition(page, (c) => c.startPhase === 'yellow', 'ĹĽĂłĹ‚ta (kolejny)')
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
  await waitForCompetition(page, (c) => c.startPhase === 'green', 'zielona (kolejny)')
  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight')
  await waitForCompetition(page, (c) => c.view === 'jump' && (c.jump?.tick ?? 0) >= 724, 'moment wybicia (kolejny)')
  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowUp')
  await waitForCompetition(page, (c) => c.jump?.phase === 'Flight', 'lot (kolejny)')
  await waitForCompetition(page, (c) => (c.jump?.heightAboveSurface ?? 99) <= 8, 'przed lÄ…dowaniem (kolejny)')
  await page.keyboard.press('KeyT')
  await waitForCompetition(page, (c) => ['result', 'round-summary', 'finished'].includes(c.view), 'wynik (kolejny)')
}

/** Dogrywa konkurs do widoku `finished`; zakĹ‚ada, ĹĽe bieĹĽÄ…cy widok to juĹĽ `result`/`round-summary`. */
async function driveCompetitionToFinish(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  let state = (await snapshot(page)).competition
  if (!state) throw new Error('Brak stanu konkursu.')
  for (let guard = 0; guard < 500 && state.view !== 'finished'; guard += 1) {
    if (state.view === 'result' || state.view === 'round-summary') {
      await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
    } else if (state.view === 'handover') {
      await playMinimalHumanJump(page)
      const next = (await snapshot(page)).competition
      if (!next) throw new Error('Brak stanu konkursu po skoku.')
      state = next
      continue
    }
    state = await waitForCompetition(
      page,
      (next) => next.view !== 'bots' || next.roundId !== state?.roundId || next.nextStartIndex !== state?.nextStartIndex,
      'kolejny krok konkursu',
      60_000,
    )
  }
  expect(state.view).toBe('finished')
}

/**
 * Wycina dokĹ‚adny prostokÄ…t z zapisanego PNG-a i zapisuje go jako osobny plik â€”
 * raz bez skalowania (dowĂłd siatki pikseli 1:1), raz powiÄ™kszony caĹ‚kowitÄ… skalÄ…
 * przez `drawImage` z `imageSmoothingEnabled = false` (nearest-neighbour, ta sama
 * flaga co w `src/app/main.ts`).
 */
async function cropAndUpscale(
  page: Page,
  sourcePngPath: string,
  region: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number },
  scale: number,
  outPath: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const fileUrl = `file:///${resolve(sourcePngPath).replace(/\\/g, '/')}`
  await page.goto(fileUrl)
  const dataUrl = await page.evaluate(
    ({ x, y, w, h, scale }) => new Promise<string>((promiseResolve, promiseReject) => {
      const image = document.images[0]
      if (!image) {
        promiseReject(new Error('Strona nie zawiera obrazu do wyciÄ™cia.'))
        return
      }
      const draw = () => {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
        canvas.width = w * scale
        canvas.height = h * scale
        const context = canvas.getContext('2d')
        if (!context) {
          promiseReject(new Error('Brak kontekstu 2D do wyciÄ™cia.'))
          return
        }
        context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false
        context.drawImage(image, x, y, w, h, 0, 0, w * scale, h * scale)
        promiseResolve(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'))
      }
      if (image.complete) draw()
      else image.onload = draw
    }),
    { x: region.x, y: region.y, w: region.w, h: region.h, scale },
  )
  const base64 = dataUrl.split(',')[1] ?? ''
  writeFileSync(outPath, Buffer.from(base64, 'base64'))
}

function buildGates(): HillGate[] {
  const gates: HillGate[] = []
  for (let number = 1; number <= GATE_COUNT; number += 1) {
    gates.push({
      number,
      inrunLengthMeters: LONGEST_INRUN_METERS - (GATE_COUNT - number) * GATE_SPACING_METERS,
    })
  }
  return gates
}

changes in the equipment over time.

# Wisla Malinka HS134 (2023).
import math


def slope_deg_at(kf, d):
    if d <= kf[0][0]:
        return kf[0][1]
    if d >= kf[-1][0]:
        return kf[-1][1]
    for i in range(1, len(kf)):
        b, a = kf[i - 1], kf[i]
        if d <= a[0]:
            span = a[0] - b[0]
            if span <= 0:
                return a[1]
            t = (d - b[0]) / span
            return b[1] + (a[1] - b[1]) * t
    return kf[-1][1]


def curve(start, kf, d0, d1, step=0.05):
    n = max(1, round((d1 - d0) / step))
    s = (d1 - d0) / n
    pts = [start]
    x, y = start
    for i in range(n):
        md = d0 + (i + 0.5) * s
        r = math.radians(slope_deg_at(kf, md))
        x += math.cos(r) * s
        y -= math.sin(r) * s
        pts.append((x, y))
    return pts


INRUN_KF = [(0, 35), (60, 35), (85, 12), (93.5, 10.5), (100, 10.5)]
LANDING_KF = [(0, 24), (15, 28), (40, 31), (75, 33.5), (105, 34), (120, 33), (134, 30.5), (145, 22), (152, 14)]

print('prog  T  ', tuple(round(v, 2) for v in inrun[-1]))

print()
print('=== ZESKOK (gra) ===')
for d in (0, 105, 120, 134, 152):

    print('  s=%3d m -> x=%7.2f  y=%7.2f  nachylenie %.1f st.' % (d, p[0], p[1], slope_deg_at(LANDING_KF, d)))

print('  K: n=%.2f m, h=%.2f m, h/n=%.3f, odleglosc skosna T-K=%.2f m' % (n, h, h / n, w_oblique))
L = at(landing, 134)
print('  L(HS): n=%.2f m, h=%.2f m, odleglosc skosna=%.2f m' % (L[0], -L[1], math.hypot(L[0], L[1])))
U = at(landing, 152)
print('  U: x=%.2f  y=%.2f' % U)
print('  koniec wybiegu: x=%.2f y=%.2f' % outrun[-1])

xs = [p[0] for p in inrun + landing + outrun]
ys = [p[1] for p in inrun + landing + outrun]
print()
print('=== ZAKRES SWIATA ===')
print('x: %.1f .. %.1f  (%.1f m)' % (min(xs), max(xs), max(xs) - min(xs)))
print('y: %.1f .. %.1f  (%.1f m)' % (min(ys), max(ys), max(ys) - min(ys)))

print()
print('=== SKALA ===')
for s in (2.075, 11.6):

          'caly obiekt %.0f x %.0f px'
          % (s, 480 / s, 270 / s, 2.5 * s, 1.8 * s, (max(xs) - min(xs)) * s, (max(ys) - min(ys)) * s))
print('  sprite w grze: narta 29 px, postawa 22 px -> wewnetrzna skala %.2f / %.2f px/m'

print()

alpha = 120 / 30 + 7.4
print('  kat progu alpha = w/30 + 7.4 = %.1f st. (zakres %.1f - %.1f)' % (alpha, 120 / 30 + 6.9, 120 / 30 + 7.9))

# Wyznacza profil zeskoku zgodny z norma FIS "Jumping Hills Construction Norm 2018"
# dla w=120 / HS=134, kalibrowany na certyfikat Wisly Malinki HS134 (2023).
#
# Norma:
#   alpha = w/30 + 7.4          (zakres w/30+6.9 .. w/30+7.9)   -> 11.4 st. (Wisla: 11.0)
#   betaP = gamma + 0.5*alpha - 2.5,  max 37 st.
#   beta0 = betaP / 6
#   h/n w zakresie w/800+0.400 .. w/1000+0.480  -> 0.550 .. 0.600  (Wisla: 0.566)
#   knoll: parabola szescienna; pole ladowania P-L: luk kolowy; L-U: parabola do 0 st.
import math

BETA_P = 37.0          # norma: gorny dopuszczalny prog
BETA_0 = BETA_P / 6.0  # 6.167 st.
BETA_K = 33.5          # certyfikat Wisla Malinka HS134
H_OVER_N = 0.566       # certyfikat Wisla Malinka HS134
K_ARC = 120.0          # punkt K = 120 m mierzone po powierzchni zeskoku
HS_ARC = 134.0
S_TABLE = 3.03         # wysokosc progu nad podstawa skoczni (Wisla)

STEP = 0.02


def knoll_points(c):
    """Parabola szescienna y = -(x*tan(b0) + c*x^3) od x=0 do xP, gdzie slope(xP)=BETA_P."""
    t0 = math.tan(math.radians(BETA_0))
    tP = math.tan(math.radians(BETA_P))
    xP = math.sqrt((tP - t0) / (3 * c))
    pts = []
    arc = 0.0
    x = 0.0
    prev = (0.0, 0.0)
    pts.append((arc, 0.0, 0.0, BETA_0))
    while x < xP:
        x = min(xP, x + STEP)
        y = -(x * t0 + c * x ** 3)
        arc += math.hypot(x - prev[0], y - prev[1])
        slope = math.degrees(math.atan(t0 + 3 * c * x * x))
        pts.append((arc, x, y, slope))
        prev = (x, y)
    return pts, xP


def profile(c, rL):
    """Zwraca liste (arc, x, y, slopeDeg) od podstawy progu do ~180 m."""
    pts, xP = knoll_points(c)
    arc, x, y = pts[-1][0], pts[-1][1], pts[-1][2]
    slope = BETA_P
    # luk kolowy: nachylenie maleje liniowo z dlugoscia luku
    while arc < 200.0:
        slope_rad = math.radians(slope)
        x += math.cos(slope_rad) * STEP
        y -= math.sin(slope_rad) * STEP
        arc += STEP
        slope -= math.degrees(STEP / rL)
        if slope <= 0.0:
            slope = 0.0
        pts.append((arc, x, y, slope))
    return pts


def sample(pts, arc_target):
    for i in range(1, len(pts)):
        if pts[i][0] >= arc_target:
            return pts[i]
    return pts[-1]


def residuals(c, rL):
    pts = profile(c, rL)
    k = sample(pts, K_ARC)
    n = k[1]
    h = -k[2] + S_TABLE   # h liczone od KRAWEDZI PROGU, a profil startuje s ponizej
    return (h / n - H_OVER_N, k[3] - BETA_K)


# proste rozwiazanie metoda Newtona po dwoch zmiennych
c, rL = 2.0e-5, 260.0
for _ in range(200):
    f1, f2 = residuals(c, rL)
    if abs(f1) < 1e-6 and abs(f2) < 1e-4:
        break
    dc, drL = c * 1e-4, rL * 1e-4
    a11 = (residuals(c + dc, rL)[0] - f1) / dc
    a12 = (residuals(c, rL + drL)[0] - f1) / drL
    a21 = (residuals(c + dc, rL)[1] - f2) / dc
    a22 = (residuals(c, rL + drL)[1] - f2) / drL
    det = a11 * a22 - a12 * a21
    if det == 0:
        break
    c -= (f1 * a22 - f2 * a12) / det
    rL -= (f2 * a11 - f1 * a21) / det

pts = profile(c, rL)
k = sample(pts, K_ARC)
print('c = %.6e   rL = %.2f m' % (c, rL))
print('betaP=%.2f  beta0=%.2f' % (BETA_P, BETA_0))
_, xP = knoll_points(c)
sP = None
for p in pts:
    if p[1] >= xP:
        sP = p[0]
        break
print('P: x=%.2f  luk=%.2f m  nachylenie=%.2f' % (xP, sP, BETA_P))
print('K: luk=%.1f  x=%.2f  y=%.2f  n=%.2f  h=%.2f  h/n=%.4f  beta=%.2f'
      % (k[0], k[1], k[2], k[1], -k[2] + S_TABLE, (-k[2] + S_TABLE) / k[1], k[3]))
l = sample(pts, HS_ARC)
print('L: luk=%.1f  x=%.2f  y=%.2f  beta=%.2f' % (l[0], l[1], l[2], l[3]))
print('odleglosc skosna T-K = %.2f m' % math.hypot(k[1], k[2] - S_TABLE))

print()
print('Nachylenie w funkcji luku (co 5 m):')
for d in range(0, 201, 5):
    p = sample(pts, float(d))
    if p[0] < d - 0.1:
        break
    print('  %3d m  x=%7.2f  y=%7.2f  %5.2f st.' % (d, p[1], p[2], p[3]))

# punkt U: nachylenie 0
u = None
for p in pts:
    if p[3] <= 0.01:
        u = p
        break
if u:
    print()
    print('U (nachylenie 0): luk=%.1f  x=%.2f  y=%.2f  Uz od progu=%.2f m' % (u[0], u[1], u[2], u[2] - S_TABLE))

## Full Option Reference

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `preset` | string | - | Active preset name (e.g. `"openai"`, `"best"`) |
| `stripOrchestratorModel` | boolean | `false` | Preserve a runtime `/model` selection for the orchestrator after subagent dispatch by omitting its configured model from the SDK config. A selected preset's explicit `orchestrator.model` is retained. Without a runtime selection, this opt-in delegates the initial orchestrator choice to OpenCode's session default. |

### Runtime Preset Switching

Presets can also be selected from the TUI with `/preset`. The selection is
written to the user config file; reload OpenCode for it to take effect. See
[Preset Switching](preset-switching.md) for details.

| `presets` | object | - | Named preset configurations |
|-----------|--------|---|-----------------------------|
| `presets.<name>.extends` | string | - | Optional single parent preset. The parent is resolved before the child; multiple parents are not supported |
| `presets.<name>.<agent>.model` | string | - | Model ID in `provider/model` format |
| `presets.<name>.<agent>.temperature` | number | - | Optional temperature (0â€“2); when omitted, OpenCode chooses its default |
| `presets.<name>.<agent>.variant` | string | - | Reasoning effort: `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"`, or `"max"` (provider-specific) |
| `presets.<name>.<agent>.displayName` | string | - | Custom user-facing alias for the agent (e.g. `"advisor"` for `oracle`) |
| `presets.<name>.<agent>.color` | string | - | Agent display color as `#RRGGBB` or a theme color: `primary`, `secondary`, `accent`, `success`, `warning`, `error`, or `info` |
| `presets.<name>.<agent>.skills` | string[] | - | Skills the agent can use (`"*"`, `"!item"`, explicit list) |
| `presets.<name>.<agent>.skills_add` | string[] | - | Skill names added to the effective skills list at config resolution (applies to `agents.<agent>` entries too). Removal via `skills_remove` wins. Folded into `skills` and stripped; see [Skills Assignment](skills.md#adding-or-removing-skills-on-top-of-an-inherited-list) |
| `presets.<name>.<agent>.skills_remove` | string[] | - | Skill names removed from the effective skills list at config resolution (applies to `agents.<agent>` entries too). Wins over `skills_add`. Folded into `skills` and stripped; see [Skills Assignment](skills.md#adding-or-removing-skills-on-top-of-an-inherited-list) |
| `presets.<name>.<agent>.mcps` | string[] | - | MCPs the agent can use (`"*"`, `"!item"`, explicit list) |
| `presets.<name>.<agent>.options` | object | - | Provider-specific model options passed to the AI SDK (e.g., `textVerbosity`, `thinking` budget) |
| `agents.<customAgent>.model` | string\|array | - | Required for custom agents inferred from unknown `agents` keys |
| `agents.<customAgent>.prompt` | string | - | Full execution prompt for a custom agent |
| `agents.<customAgent>.orchestratorPrompt` | string | - | Exact `@agent` block injected into the orchestrator prompt; must start with `@<agent-name>` |
| `agents.<agent>.permission` | object \| string | - | Tool-level permission rules enforced by the SDK. See [Agent Permissions](#agent-permissions) |
Model selection follows these rules:

- If the same effective agent override contains both `model` and
  `inheritModelFrom`, the explicit `model` wins.
- If `model` is omitted, `inheritModelFrom` is an explicit higher-layer
  directive: it clears a lower-layer `model` value, including a model supplied
  by the host agent configuration, and resolves the requested source.
- If neither field is present, the existing model precedence and the historical
  fixer-to-librarian fallback remain unchanged.

The setting works in both root `agents` overrides and preset agent overrides.

### Agent Colors

Built-in agents ship without a default `color`, so the OpenCode TUI assigns
each one a distinct color from its own theme-aware palette. Set `color`
explicitly if you want a fixed color for a built-in or custom agent, using a
six-digit hex value or an OpenCode theme color:

```jsonc
{
  "agents": {
    "oracle": { "color": "#FF5733" },
    "reviewer": {
      "model": "openai/gpt-6",
      "color": "info"
    }
  }
}
```

Theme colors adapt to the active OpenCode theme. Dynamic councillors inherit
the configured `council` color unless `agents.councillor.color` overrides it.
`color` works in top-level `agents` overrides and inside `presets`.

### Per-preset agent configuration

To get per-preset behavior for any agent, built-in (`council`, `oracle`,
`explorer`, `librarian`, `fixer`, `designer`, `observer`) or custom, define
the agent override inside each preset block, not in root `agents`.

```jsonc
{
  "presets": {
    "balanced": {
      "council": { "model": ["opencode/mimo-v2.5-free", "opencode-go/minimax-m3", "opencode/minimax-m3"] },
      "oracle": { "model": "opencode/big-pickle", "variant": "high" },
      "skeptic": { "model": ["opencode/big-pickle", "opencode-go/qwen3.7-plus"], "variant": "max" }
    },
    "nvidia-free": {
      "council": { "model": ["nvidia/z-ai/glm-5.2", "nvidia/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6"] },
      "oracle": { "model": "nvidia/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro", "variant": "high" },
      "skeptic": { "model": ["nvidia/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro", "nvidia/mistralai/mistral-large-3-675b-instruct-2512"], "variant": "max" }
    }
  }
}
```

#### Agent precedence

For overlapping agent fields, the effective precedence is:

**ancestor < child < root `agents` < host config**

An ancestor supplies defaults, the child preset overrides them, the plugin's
top-level `agents` object overrides the active preset, and the agent entry in
OpenCode's `opencode.json` is the final override. A root `agents` entry is
global rather than per-preset, so put an agent inside each preset when its
value should vary by preset. This precedence also applies after `/preset`

# oh-my-opencode-slim Configuration Documentation

## Config File Location

The configuration file is located at `~/.config/opencode/oh-my-opencode-slim.json`

## Configuration Schema

The bundled example shows the basic structure:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://unpkg.com/oh-my-opencode-slim@latest/oh-my-opencode-slim.schema.json",
  "preset": "openai",
  "presets": {
    "openai": {
      "orchestrator": { "model": "openai/gpt-6-sol", "variant": "high", "skills": ["*"], "mcps": ["*", "!context7"] },
      "oracle": { "model": "openai/gpt-6-astra", "variant": "high", "skills": ["simplify"], "mcps": [] },
      "librarian": { "model": "openai/gpt-6-luna", "variant": "low", "skills": [], "mcps": ["context7", "gh_grep"] },
      "explorer": { "model": "openai/gpt-6-luna", "variant": "low", "skills": [], "mcps": [] },
      "designer": { "model": "openai/gpt-6-luna", "variant": "medium", "skills": [], "mcps": [] },
      "fixer": { "model": "openai/gpt-6-luna", "variant": "high", "skills": [], "mcps": [] }
    }
  }
}
```

## Core Configuration Elements

**Presets:** Collections of agent configurations that can be switched at runtime using `/preset`. Presets support inheritance via `extends` property, allowing child presets to override only specific agent models.

**Agent Structure:** Each agent configuration includes:
- `model`: Provider/model identifier (e.g., "openai/gpt-6-sol")
- `variant`: Performance level (`"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"`)
- `skills`: Array of skill names, `"*"` for all, or `"!skill-name"` to deny specific skills
- `mcps`: Array of MCP names with similar deny syntax

## Seven Primary Agents

1. **Orchestrator** â€” Strategic coordinator and task delegator
2. **Explorer** â€” Codebase reconnaissance specialist
3. **Oracle** â€” Strategic advisor and architectural reviewer
4. **Council** â€” Multi-model consensus synthesizer
5. **Librarian** â€” External knowledge retrieval
6. **Designer** â€” UI/UX implementation
7. **Fixer** â€” Implementation specialist

## Optional Agent

**Observer** â€” Visual analysis of images and diagrams (disabled by default; enable with `"disabled_agents": []`)

## Documentation Links

- **[Configuration](/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/blob/master/docs/configuration.md)** â€” Full reference including prompt overrides and all options
- **[Project Customization](/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/blob/master/docs/project-local-customization.md)** â€” Repository-specific overrides
- **[Preset Switching](/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/blob/master/docs/preset-switching.md)** â€” Runtime model swapping
- **[OpenAI Preset](/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/blob/master/docs/openai-preset.md)** and **[OpenCode Go Preset](/alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim/blob/master/docs/opencode-go-preset.md)** â€” Provider-specific examples

# Configuration Reference Summary

## Key Configuration Files

The system uses layered configuration with this precedence:

1. **User config** (`~/.config/opencode/oh-my-opencode-slim.jsonc`)
2. **Project-local overrides** (`.opencode/oh-my-opencode-slim.json`)

> "Use the `.jsonc` extension to add comments and trailing commas. If both `.jsonc` and `.json` exist, `.jsonc` takes precedence."

## Model Arrays & Fallback Chains

Models support array notation for fallback sequences:

```jsonc
{
  "presets": {
    "balanced": {
      "council": { "model": ["opencode/mimo-v2.5-free", "opencode-go/minimax-m3"] },
      "oracle": { "model": ["opencode/big-pickle", "opencode-go/qwen3.7-plus"] }
    }
  }
}
```

The system attempts each model in sequence on failover. > "A value of `0` disables Slim's foreground 429 failover budget; it does not prevent OpenCode from retrying a provider request."

## Variant Field

The `variant` field controls reasoning effort across providers:

> "Reasoning effort: `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"`, or `"max"` (provider-specific)"

You can set variants per-preset or per-agent.

## Fallback Configuration

Control retry behavior through these settings:

- `fallback.maxRetries`: Max consecutive 429 responses before advancing fallback chain
- `fallback.initialRetryDelayMs`: Pre-fallback delay (allows recovery attempts)
- `fallback.retryDelayMs`: Spacing between consecutive fallback attempts

## Project-Local Override Precedence

For overlapping agent fields, the effective order is:

> "ancestor < child < root `agents` < host config"

Project-local `.opencode/` settings override user-level configuration.

## Prompt Directory Lookup

Custom prompts follow this resolution order:

1. Project preset-specific: `.opencode/oh-my-opencode-slim/<preset>/<agent>.md`
2. Project preset-agnostic: `.opencode/oh-my-opencode-slim/<agent>.md`
3. User preset-specific: `~/.config/opencode/oh-my-opencode-slim/<preset>/<agent>.md`
4. User preset-agnostic: `~/.config/opencode/oh-my-opencode-slim/<agent>.md`

/**
 * P07 â€” ograniczone krzywe CL/CD i siĹ‚y aerodynamiczne.
 *
 * ADAPT/TUNE: krzywe sÄ… jawnÄ… tabelÄ… modelu gry. Nie deklarujemy zgodnoĹ›ci z
 * pomiarami tunelowymi rzeczywistego zawodnika. Tabela jest ograniczona na obu
 * koĹ„cach, wiÄ™c ĹĽadna pozycja nie daje nieograniczonej noĹ›noĹ›ci.
 */

import type { Vec2 } from './hill'

export type CoefficientPoint = {
  readonly angleOfAttackDeg: number
  readonly lift: number
  readonly drag: number
}

/** KÄ…t natarcia = kÄ…t sylwetki minus kÄ…t toru lotu wzglÄ™dem strumienia. */
export const COEFFICIENT_CURVE: readonly CoefficientPoint[] = [
  { angleOfAttackDeg: -15, lift: -0.3, drag: 0.46 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 0, lift: 0.25, drag: 0.37 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 10, lift: 0.78, drag: 0.42 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 20, lift: 0.88, drag: 0.58 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 26, lift: 0.88, drag: 0.68 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 30, lift: 1.14, drag: 0.78 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 32, lift: 1.09, drag: 0.77 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 34, lift: 1.06, drag: 0.82 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 35, lift: 1.02, drag: 0.9 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 36, lift: 0.75, drag: 1.4 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 40, lift: 0.78, drag: 1.38 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 50, lift: 0.58, drag: 1.62 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 65, lift: 0.44, drag: 1.8 },
  { angleOfAttackDeg: 90, lift: 0.28, drag: 1.9 },
]

export function coefficientsAt(angleOfAttackDeg: number): { lift: number; drag: number } {
  const first = COEFFICIENT_CURVE[0]
  const last = COEFFICIENT_CURVE[COEFFICIENT_CURVE.length - 1]
  if (!first || !last) throw new Error('Pusta krzywa wspĂłĹ‚czynnikĂłw.')
  if (angleOfAttackDeg <= first.angleOfAttackDeg) return { lift: first.lift, drag: first.drag }
  if (angleOfAttackDeg >= last.angleOfAttackDeg) return { lift: last.lift, drag: last.drag }

  for (let index = 1; index < COEFFICIENT_CURVE.length; index += 1) {
    const before = COEFFICIENT_CURVE[index - 1]
    const after = COEFFICIENT_CURVE[index]
    if (!before || !after) break
    if (angleOfAttackDeg <= after.angleOfAttackDeg) {
      const t = (angleOfAttackDeg - before.angleOfAttackDeg) / (after.angleOfAttackDeg - before.angleOfAttackDeg)
      return {
        lift: before.lift + (after.lift - before.lift) * t,
        drag: before.drag + (after.drag - before.drag) * t,
      }
    }
  }
  return { lift: last.lift, drag: last.drag }
}

export type AeroInput = {
  readonly velocity: Vec2
  readonly windVelocity: Vec2
  readonly pitchRad: number
  readonly airDensity: number
  readonly referenceAreaSquareMeters: number
  readonly dragScale?: number
  /**
   * PRE-PKG-008-FIXES: kara za skrajnie opuszczony dziĂłb w fazie lotu.
   * Ustawiana przez symulacjÄ™ tylko w `Flight`; w `LandingPrep` postura
   * schodzi wzdĹ‚uĹĽ stoku do lÄ…dowania i nie jest karana. DomyĹ›lnie brak kary,
   * ĹĽeby testy jednostkowe samej krzywej CL/CD pozostaĹ‚y czyste.
   */
  readonly applyNoseDownPenalty?: boolean
  /**
   * PRE-PKG-008-FIXES runda 2: kara wczesnego podejĹ›cia do lÄ…dowania.
   * Ustawiana tylko w `LandingPrep` wejĹ›ciowo przed progiem wieku lotu;
   * pĂłĹşne normalne przygotowanie nie jest karane. RozĹ‚Ä…czna z karÄ… dziobu
   * (osobna faza).
   */
  readonly applyLandingApproachPenalty?: boolean
}

/**
 * PRE-PKG-008-FIXES: jawna nieefektywnoĹ›Ä‡ skrajnego opuszczenia dziobu.
 *
 * WzglÄ™dny AoA potrafi zostaÄ‡ w wydajnym zakresie takĹĽe przy locie â€žna dziĂłb"
 * sunÄ…cym wzdĹ‚uĹĽ stoku (pitch i tor schodzÄ… razem w dĂłĹ‚), wiÄ™c sama krzywa
 * CL/CD nie karze takiego Ĺ›lizgu. PowyĹĽej progu postura jest wolna; poniĹĽej
 * progu noĹ›noĹ›Ä‡ spada liniowo, a opĂłr roĹ›nie â€” lokalna reguĹ‚a, bez twardego
 * limitu metrĂłw i bez zmian w punktacji. PrĂłg â�’10Â° trzyma normalny lot `Flight`
 * (idealny ~18â€“23Â°, takĹĽe przedĹ‚uĹĽony wiatrem pod narty do ~â�’9Â°) poza istotnÄ…
 * karÄ…; exploit schodzi do â�’26Â° i dostaje ~0,68Ă— lift, ~1,56Ă— drag.
 */
export const NOSE_DOWN_PITCH_THRESHOLD_DEG = -10

export function noseDownEfficiency(pitchDeg: number): { liftScale: number; dragScale: number } {
  if (!Number.isFinite(pitchDeg)) throw new Error('Pitch musi byÄ‡ skoĹ„czony.')
  const depth = NOSE_DOWN_PITCH_THRESHOLD_DEG - pitchDeg
  if (depth <= 0) return { liftScale: 1, dragScale: 1 }
  return {
    liftScale: Math.max(0.4, 1 - 0.02 * depth),
    dragScale: 1 + 0.035 * depth,
  }
}

/**
 * PKG-008: kara wczesnego podejĹ›cia do lÄ…dowania.
 * WybĂłr lÄ…dowania w oknie wczesnym (lot < 1,0 s) psuje szybowanie:
 * 0,60Ă— noĹ›noĹ›ci i 1,60Ă— oporu przez caĹ‚y `LandingPrep`, wiÄ™c natychmiastowe
 * T/R z belki 8 koĹ„czy â‰Ą15 m krĂłcej od prawidĹ‚owego i nie dalej niĹĽ Kâ�’10 m.
 * PĂłĹşne normalne przygotowanie nie dotyka tej kary (flaga symulacji).
 */
export const LANDING_APPROACH_LIFT_SCALE = 0.6
export const LANDING_APPROACH_DRAG_SCALE = 1.6

export type AeroResult = {
  /** SiĹ‚a wypadkowa aerodynamiczna [N]. */
  readonly force: Vec2
  readonly angleOfAttackDeg: number
  readonly airSpeed: number
  readonly lift: number
  readonly drag: number
}

/**
 * `vAir = vJumper â�’ vWind`. OpĂłr jest przeciwny do `vAir`, noĹ›noĹ›Ä‡ prostopadĹ‚a
 * do niego. Wiatr w PKG-002 jest zerowy; pole wektorowe wchodzi z P10, ale wzĂłr
 * juĹĽ go uĹĽywa, ĹĽeby konwencja znaku nie zmieniĹ‚a siÄ™ pĂłĹşniej.
 */
export function aerodynamicForce(input: AeroInput): AeroResult {
  const airX = input.velocity.x - input.windVelocity.x
  const airY = input.velocity.y - input.windVelocity.y
  const airSpeed = Math.hypot(airX, airY)

  if (airSpeed < 1e-6) {
    return { force: { x: 0, y: 0 }, angleOfAttackDeg: 0, airSpeed: 0, lift: 0, drag: 0 }
  }

  const flowAngleRad = Math.atan2(airY, airX)
  const angleOfAttackDeg = ((input.pitchRad - flowAngleRad) * 180) / Math.PI
  const base = coefficientsAt(angleOfAttackDeg)
  // Krzywa AoA zostaje bez zmian; kary dotyczÄ… wyĹ‚Ä…cznie reĹĽimu lotu.
  let lift = base.lift
  let drag = base.drag
  if (input.applyNoseDownPenalty) {
    const pitchDeg = (input.pitchRad * 180) / Math.PI
    const efficiency = noseDownEfficiency(pitchDeg)
    lift *= efficiency.liftScale
    drag *= efficiency.dragScale
  }
  if (input.applyLandingApproachPenalty) {
    lift *= LANDING_APPROACH_LIFT_SCALE
    drag *= LANDING_APPROACH_DRAG_SCALE
  }

  const dynamicPressure = 0.5 * input.airDensity * airSpeed * airSpeed * input.referenceAreaSquareMeters
  const dragMagnitude = dynamicPressure * drag * (input.dragScale ?? 1)
  const liftMagnitude = dynamicPressure * lift

  const unitX = airX / airSpeed
  const unitY = airY / airSpeed
  // NoĹ›noĹ›Ä‡ prostopadle do strumienia, w stronÄ™ â€ždo gĂłryâ€ť wzglÄ™dem toru.
  const liftX = -unitY
  const liftY = unitX

  return {
    force: {
      x: -unitX * dragMagnitude + liftX * liftMagnitude,
      y: -unitY * dragMagnitude + liftY * liftMagnitude,
    },
    angleOfAttackDeg,
    airSpeed,
    lift,
    drag,
  }
}

const RADIANS_PER_DEGREE = Math.PI / 180

function degrees(radians: number): number {
  return radians / RADIANS_PER_DEGREE

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, value))

export class JumpSimulation {

  readonly flightTrail: Vec2[] = []

  private readonly startInrunDistance: number

  constructor(config: JumpConfig = {}) {
    this.hill = config.hill ?? buildHill()
    this.params = config.params ?? DEFAULT_JUMP_PARAMS
    this.gateNumber = config.gateNumber ?? 8
    this.windVelocity = config.windVelocity ?? { x: 0, y: 0 }
    this.currentWindUserMetersPerSecond = physicsVelocityToUserWind(this.windVelocity)
    this.windField = config.windField ?? null
    this.windMeasurementAccumulator = this.windField
      ? new WeightedWindMeasurement(this.hill.spec.windMeasurement.sensors)

    this.autoStart = config.autoStart ?? false

    const gate = this.hill.gate(this.gateNumber)

    this.inrunDistanceMeters = this.startInrunDistance

    this.pitchRad = -this.hill.inrunCurve.slopeRadAt(this.inrunDistanceMeters)
    this.targetPitchRad = this.pitchRad
    this.updateWind(false)

  }
